body:
Founder follow-up ('1') on the P1/P2 gamepad fix: opens up to two SDL controllers (g_pad/g_pad2) with hotplug handled for both. One pad still goes to P2 (preserves the single-pad fix); a second pad takes over P1 instead of staying keyboard-only. New shared apply_pad_to_tipjar_input() helper. Verified: gcc -fsyntax-only clean, scripts/build.sh build + physics smoke test pass. Commit 09a7ff1.

⚓ ☃
title: TIPJAR: real dual-pad support, two controllers = two players
